INSERT INTO leave_balances (employee_id, leave_type_id, year, entitled_days, carried_forward)
            SELECT employee_id, leave_type_id, year, entitled_days, GREATEST(carried_forward, 0::numeric)
            FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[], $3::int4[], $4::numeric[], $5::numeric[])
                AS t(employee_id, leave_type_id, year, entitled_days, carried_forward)
            ON CONFLICT (employee_id, leave_type_id, year)
            DO UPDATE SET carried_forward = GREATEST(EXCLUDED.carried_forward, 0::numeric), updated_at = NOW()
